subject: Emotions
title: Love and Identity Loss
description: A short lesson to help you apply Love and Identity Loss.

hook.text: After 20 years of marriage, she doesn't know what music she likes. Her identity merged with his until hers disappeared.

buildup.text: Aron's self-expansion theory: lovers include each other in their sense of self. Two become one—literally in the brain.

discovery.text: Moderate inclusion is healthy—new interests, perspectives, growth. But extreme merger erases individual identity.

twist.text: Those with fragile self-concepts are most vulnerable. Without a firm identity before love, love becomes your whole self.

climax.text: Breakups hit identity-merged people hardest. They don't just lose a partner—they lose the person they'd become.

punchline.text: Love should expand who you are. Not replace it.

quiz.question: What is Aron's self-expansion theory about?
options: Lovers include each other in their sense of self
